chapters.title: 1. Prologue: Beyond Fragmented Platforms
chapters.body:
Legacy digital platforms split identity, communication, payments, apps, and compute across closed silos that extract control from the user.

Trinity Omni-Core unites Messenger, @wallet, AI Studio, Domains, and Edge Compute into a single sovereign architecture — with Tetrakis ($TTK) serving as its native Base L2 ERC-20 utility currency.

chapters.title: 2. Origin of Tetrakis (Sacred Geometry & Four Utility Pillars)
chapters.body:
The name Tetrakis comes from the tetrahedron — the most structurally stable solid in three-dimensional space: four vertices, four faces, complete balance.

Those four vertices define the four native ecosystem roles of Tetrakis ($TTK): In-Chat Payments & Instant P2P Transfers, Mini-Apps & AI Studio Bot Economy, Domains & Digital Assets, and Creator & Compute Economy inside a user-owned Non-Custodial Tetrakis Space.

chapters.title: 3. Utility of $TTK: Native Currency of the Trinity Ecosystem
chapters.body:
$TTK is engineered as practical utility fuel across Trinity rather than a speculative promise. Its fixed 1,000,000,000 TTK ERC-20 supply (zero tax, no mint function) powers native in-chat P2P transfers, AI Studio mini-apps, domain and handle services, creator payouts, and non-custodial settlement.

Under Truth Policy 2.1, Trinity strictly distinguishes this ecosystem utility architecture from verified on-chain state: contract deployment is only treated as active after live RPC and keccak256 bytecode verification, and no market price or automatic credit unlock is ever fabricated.

chapters.title: 4. Finale: The Architect's Oath
chapters.body: "We do not build servers that can be switched off. We do not build a currency that can be inflated. Tetrakis is a sovereign utility foundation locked in immutable code. Ring 0 holds the key. The future is autonomous."

tetrahedronPillars.name: Native In-Chat Payments & Instant P2P Transfers
tetrahedronPillars.description: Direct wallet-to-wallet $TTK transfers, tipping, and payment requests inside Trinity Messenger and @wallet without leaving the chat.

tetrahedronPillars.name: Mini-Apps, AI Studio & Bot Economy
tetrahedronPillars.description: Native payment currency for Trinity AI Studio web apps, autonomous agents, skills, plugins, and micro-services across the ecosystem.

tetrahedronPillars.name: Domains, Handles & Digital Assets
tetrahedronPillars.description: Utility token for ecosystem usernames and handles, domain services, hosting, and verifiable digital assets or collectibles.

tetrahedronPillars.name: Creator & Compute Economy / Non-Custodial Space
tetrahedronPillars.description: User-owned non-custodial Tetrakis Space alongside @wallet where private keys stay with the user, enabling creator payouts, edge compute/storage settlement, and ecosystem participation.
